recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core reconciliation. If a similar bug appears in the modern publisher, handle it in the current publisher/kindling codebase rather than reopening this already-applied FHIR-core source issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13576 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 change request reporting that the IG Publisher created a spurious c:\temp\test.map file on macOS while processing structure mapping scripts. The approved resolution was to use OS-appropriate temp-file creation.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed commit was found for FHIR-13576. Git pickaxe identified commit 83d1de23560413555db1b0f1e3dee07bd016685e, "remove bogus debugging statement from IG publisher," as the implicit application because it deleted TextFile.stringToFile(b.toString(), "c:\\temp\\test.map") from the STU3 StructureMapUtilities code used by the IG Publisher.
additional_context: Zulip discussion in #committers > IG Publisher enhancements confirms that the c:\temp\test.map artifact was created by the IG Publisher and linked to GF#13576. Commit 56ceb0df08 later removed the old in-tree IG Publisher because it had moved to Maven, and the current build depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling for org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current-source searches found no test.map, c:\temp, or c:/temp hard-coded temp-map path, and the old IG Publisher implementation that contained the bug is no longer present in this checkout.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request reporting that IG Publisher created a spurious c:\temp\test.map file for structure mapping scripts on macOS.
evidence_items.learned: The final requested correction was to avoid the hard-coded Windows temp path, and a later Jira comment says the problem no longer existed.

evidence_items.summary: June 2017 messages discuss c:\temp\test.map being generated by the IG Publisher and Eric Haas links the recurring artifact to GF#13576.
evidence_items.learned: The community discussion confirms the Jira described a tool/debugging artifact rather than a normative spec content change.

evidence_items.summary: Commit "remove bogus debugging statement from IG publisher" deleted TextFile.stringToFile(b.toString(), "c:\\temp\\test.map") from StructureMapUtilities.
evidence_items.learned: This is the implicit source application that removed the offending hard-coded path.

evidence_items.summary: Commit "Remove IG publisher (it's gone to Maven)" removed the old in-tree IG Publisher test assets and related source ownership from this checkout.
evidence_items.learned: Current FHIR-core source is not the place to reapply this old IG Publisher fix.

evidence_items.summary: The current build depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling version 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the build classpath.
evidence_items.learned: Publisher implementation behavior now comes through kindling rather than the removed historical IG Publisher source.
